B1.note: One filtered tip set (refs/heads, refs/remotes, refs/tags; tags peeled ^{commit}; commit-only), used by ls-tree, W+commit count, E, N_c, rev-list and tag signatures. No HEAD dependence.

B2.note: Own paths never enter N_c (comm -23 npaths cp). But K-STATUS is mapped to SELF_ATTESTED by channel id before any data (l.136). overlap_norm is structurally NA for K-STATUS (npaths is a subset of cp). PROGRAM_STATUS.md, approvals and signoffs are forced SELF_ATTESTED, and the headline counts that as a negative.

B3.note: Root-based pathspecs over all history reachable from the tips; the glob exclusion matches the classifier. Remaining leak: a rename from a non-vocabulary name inside a code root (disclosed). Not --full-history (NB-1).

B4.note: %ae only in E, W_c and N_c; doc/governance roots not in E. READMEs inside the code roots still count (NB-4).

B5.note: K-DEPLOY out of cfg; Q2 = STATE_RECORD_BY_TYPE, Q5 = ND.

N1.note: Q5 = ND for every evidenced row; NO_BY_TYPE removed.

N2.note: INDEPENDENT reachable (K-DEPLOY only); headline computed from Q7 column; Q6 single outcome declared.

N4.note: Unsets and the -c overrides on every call verified. Residual: GIT_CONFIG, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_GRAFT_FILE and info/grafts not neutralized (NB-2).

N6.note: rc1 PASS, rc0 FAIL, rc>=2 FAIL; both FAIL cases exit 1.

N9.note: ls-tree -z with \001 carry, restored before pathspec and hashing; tab-safe splitting.

N14.note: Four neutral headline tokens defined in PROTOCOL §5.

reachability.independent_example: deploy/production.yml written only by ops@x; docs/rulings/R-001.md written only by chair@x; app/Foo.php written only by dev@x. K-DEPLOY: np=1, nnp=1, W={ops}, N_c={chair}, E={dev}, overlaps 0, so Q7=INDEPENDENT_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL and headline=LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_AT_IDENTITY_COUNT_LEVEL.
forced_negatives: K-STATUS Q7 SELF_ATTESTED (data-independent; counted as negative in headline bucket LOCAL_NO_INDEPENDENT_CANDIDATE_OBSERVED)

regressions.note: repo-local config readable (declared); GIT_CONFIG/GIT_COMMON_DIR/GIT_GRAFT_FILE not unset
no blob read; no cap on per-path log / per-commit cat-file (NB-8)

blocking.summary: K-STATUS Q7 is SELF_ATTESTED by channel id regardless of data. overlap_norm is structurally NA because npaths is a subset of the K-STATUS paths. Non-register records (PROGRAM_STATUS.md, approvals, signoffs, progress) are forced into it, and the headline counts it as a negative: a forced negative.
blocking.fix: Split into disjoint K-NORMREG (register subset; SELF_ATTESTED/IND declared) and K-STATUS (other records), run as observable with N_c = K-NORMREG paths minus own paths; count SELF_ATTESTED separately in the headline.

nonblocking.summary: W/E/N_c git log without --full-history; default simplification can prune commits and undercount overlaps (possible unqualified positive).
GIT_CONFIG (can hide extensions.partialClone / core.hooksPath), GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_GRAFT_FILE and .git/info/grafts not neutralized.
Norm-register regex (l.89) lacks a trailing token boundary (registration, norms, normal...); authoriz alone unreachable.
READMEs/markdown inside code roots count as executor work, contrary to §3.
cat-file|awk early exit under pipefail: signed commits larger than the pipe buffer get SIGPIPE and are counted unsigned (extends N7).
On identity-guard FAIL the output stays in OUT; only exit 1 and the FAIL line signal it.
K-LOCALHOOK checks per-worktree gitdir hooks, not the common dir (N8 family).
No cap on per-path full-history log passes or per-commit cat-file spawns.
A single sweeping commit can place one author in W_c, N_c and E; observed, but should be disclosed.
Positive Q7 reachable only for K-DEPLOY; state this in §3. CHANGELOG line count is off by one (170).
